chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Najiyyah, who said:

I said to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام: “The time of salat comes upon me, so should I begin with the supererogatory prayer?” He said: “No. Begin with the obligatory prayer and make up the supererogatory prayer afterward.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام addressed in the narration
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the prescribed time of salat (prayer) that becomes due
key_terms.النَّافِلَةِ: the supererogatory prayer performed in addition to the obligation
key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory salat that must be performed first

ai.seo_question: If the time of obligatory salat enters, should I pray the nafilah first or the faridah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when the time of the obligatory salat has entered, one should begin with the obligatory prayer rather than the supererogatory one. It establishes the precedence of the faridah over the nafilah, while allowing the nafilah to be performed later as a make-up.
